title: fix(adaptive): bound the growth planner by the geometry it works, not only path length
body:
## What changed

The growth-ring planner (`adaptive/grow.rs`) was bounded only by #13's length budget. On the island fixture it ran ~53 s in release (this machine; the issue measured ~68 s) before that budget refused it.

`adaptive/budget.rs` (`Work`, `GEOM_MAX`, `GEOM_LEN`) adds a third budget law. Each trial step counts the polygon vertices it works through (the cleared area it offsets, the ring it opens, and each revolution's margin area) beside the revolution length #13 already sums. A plan is refused by name once it has worked past **600 k vertices AND walked past 5,000 tool radii** of revolutions. Both counts are summed over every margin attempt, and both are deterministic: no wall clock, not even as a backstop. The refusal goes through the existing `refused` path, so the named trochoid -> Offset-ring fallback is unchanged. `LEAST_WORK_MAX` and `WORK_MAX` are unchanged, and `mod.rs` stays at 435 lines.

### Rework after the heavy-lane check (first head 735c9106)

The first cut refused on vertices alone (500 k). It cut a level of the user's STEP bore that plans on main: 33 revolutions over a finely tessellated outline, 1.14 M vertices, 2.6 k r of walk.

Measured: the planner's time is in `rings::open` (the morphological opening) and grows about with the **square** of the ring's vertices per trial, ~60-100 ns per vertex^2 on the slot, the island and the bore alike. The bore spends **200 s** of growth on one level on main, more than the island's whole run. So **no time-faithful deterministic unit can keep the bore and refuse the island sooner**: any budget the bore fits under, the island fits under too.

The rule therefore bounds what the bore does not do, which is walk far. Every plan that finishes on main is either light (at most 358 k vertices) or short (the bore). The plans that never finish are heavy and long well before #13 catches them. The bore's own 200 s is filed as #882 (cheaper per-trial geometry, which changes toolpaths). The full reasoning and the dropped options are in `docs/decisions/850-adaptive-geometry-budget.md`.

## Measurement table (release, main semantics = the budget lifted; counts deterministic)

| fixture (lane) | on main | revs | vertices | walk (r) | growth time |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| user's STEP bore, one level (app `pocket3d_hsm`, heavy) | Done | 33 | 1,138,443 | 2,595 | 200 s |
| rotary r6.2 neck lvl 1 (`rotary_adaptive`, heavy) | Done | 99 | 357,937 | 14,026 | 7.4 s |
| rotary developed level (heavy) | Done | 112 | 333,172 | 17,593 | 7.2 s |
| rotary r6.2 neck lvl 2 (heavy) | Done | 113 | 305,905 | 15,556 | 6.4 s |
| boss island (app `pick_agnostic`, heavy) | Done | 67 | 289,301 | 3,094 | 4.5 s |
| 60x14 slot (`adaptive_hsm`) | Done | 109 | 252,528 | 6,072 | 3.6 s |
| 60x22 channel (`adaptive_hsm`) | Done | 37 | 175,217 | 2,251 | 3.8 s |
| rotary developed window (heavy) | Done | 72 | 171,398 | 5,701 | 5.0 s |
| whole_model_pocket / level_links / pocket_overhead (debug suites) | Done | <= 37 | <= 73,496 | - | - |
| island 60x40, 12x12 | refused by #13 | 146+163 | 864,899+1,086,955 | 30,222 | 48 s |
| stepped block Z -10 (motion `pocket3d_hsm`, heavy) | refused by #13 | 146+180 | 834,155+1,053,615 | 30,032 | 48 s |
| rotary developed level / window (heavy) | refused by #13 | 144+86 | ~380 k+206 k | ~30,100 | 11 s |
| 14 / 20 mm band, shoulder | refused up front (#13) | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |

**Margins:**
- Finishing plans past 5 k r stay <= 358 k vertices: `GEOM_MAX` is 1.68x over them.
- The one heavy finishing plan (the bore) walks 2.6 k r: `GEOM_LEN` is 1.93x over it.
- The slot and the channel are pinned at 1.9x.

## Island bound (whole pocket: growth, trochoid refusal, Offset rings)

| | main | this PR (final code) |
|---|---|---|
| release | 52.6 s | **18.7-22.0 s** across runs (109 revs, ~600 k vertices, ~9.4 k r) |
| debug | not measured (> 1 min by ratio) | **46.2 s** (author) / **58.8 s** (reviewer) - both on a loaded machine |

- The 14 mm band: refused up front, 0.14 s release, before and after.
- The stepped block: now refused at 111 revs instead of 180, same outcome as on main.
- The rotary developed levels: still refused by #13's length budget at 86 revs, with the same message as on main.

## Bore: main vs PR (release)

The bore test now prints a digest of the whole path (`DefaultHasher` over the `Debug` of every move).

| code | moves | planar | arcs | digest |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| motion code of the branch base bdd29e00 (main) | 5530 | 5497 | 600 | `a91f154b99d44f62` |
| this PR, code head ecb54b7f | 5530 | 5497 | 600 | `a91f154b99d44f62` |

The two paths are identical. The notes are identical too: only Z 20.000 goes to the rings, because its plan crosses itself, as on main.

## Pinning tests

- `adaptive_hsm::the_island_is_refused_by_the_geometry_budget_in_seconds` (**heavy lane** since the review round: `#[ignore = "heavy lane: release --ignored ..."]`, 46-59 s debug was at the 60 s law; 18.7-20.5 s release). Checks:
  - the refusal is named;
  - the vertex count in the note is 600.0..=620.0 k, so the plan was refused within one revolution (deterministic);
  - the Offset rings cut the pocket, chained and finite, and the verifier is silent;
  - a loose wall-clock backstop: 600 s debug, 60 s release.
- **Fast default-suite twin, `adaptive::budget::fixtures::the_island_trips_lowered_geometry_limits_by_name` (1.8 s debug).** It drives the planner's own loop on the island through the private `plan_within` with a test-only `Work::with_limits(20_000, 200.0)` (no global, no env var). It asserts the refusal is named ("both limits passed", each limit stated) and that it goes through the plan's `refused` path with no passes. The Offset-ring fallback that `pocket_hsm` takes on that path is pinned fast by `adaptive_band`, and in full by the heavy island pin.
- App `pocket3d_hsm::the_users_bore_roughs_adaptive_level_by_level_and_verifies_clean` (heavy):
  - **asserts the per-level strategy**: no budget refusal, and exactly one rings level (Z 20.000, crossing);
  - **asserts the path counts**: 5530 moves, 5497 planar feeds, 600 arcs. This replaces the printed `DefaultHasher` digest, which is not stable across Rust releases.
- `adaptive::tests::a_channel_is_grown_as_one_spiral_that_never_crosses` (debug): the slot stays within a 1.9x margin.
- `adaptive::budget::fixtures::the_fixtures_that_grow_today_stay_under_the_geometry_budget` (heavy): the slot and channel pockets at a 1.9x margin.
- `adaptive::budget::tests::the_geometry_budget_refuses_by_name_and_saturates`: the `Work` unit test, including "heavy but short is not refused" and the refusal wording.
- `adaptive::budget::tests::a_nan_length_neither_refuses_nor_disables_the_budget` (new).

**`#[test]` count:** up by 2 (fast twin, NaN test). The island pin moved lanes; it was not removed.

The rotary and boss counts cannot be pinned from inside the motion lib: their tests are integration tests and the counter is crate-private. Their heavy tests' own laws, the table above and the run below are their record.

## Gate

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base origin/main`: **green** (motion lib + adaptive_band + adaptive_hsm + pocket3d_hsm 143 s; app pocket3d_hsm build 259 s).
- clippy `-D warnings`: motion `--all-targets` and app `--test pocket3d_hsm` clean.
- **Heavy lanes, release, code head ecb54b7f, one binary at a time: all 13 pass.** The counters and limits are unchanged since then; only test plumbing and wording changed.

| test | result | time | refusal lines |
|---|---|---|---|
| app pocket3d_hsm::the_users_bore_... | ok | 206 s | none (only the Z 20 crossing, as on main) |
| rotary_adaptive::adaptive_plans_the_developed_levels_... | ok | 136 s | "planning budget after 86 revolutions" (length, as main) |
| rotary_adaptive::the_developed_window_reaches_the_planner_... | ok | 30 s | 2x "planning budget after 86 revolutions" (length, as main) |
| rotary_adaptive::the_r62_neck_levels_are_refused_for_travel_by_name | ok | 39 s | none from the budgets |
| motion pocket3d_hsm::the_stepped_block_... | ok | 26 s | geometry: "after 111 revolutions (~607 k ... ~10 k r)" (main: length, 180 revs) |
| adaptive_hsm::hsm_report_full_resolution | ok | 95 s | island: geometry "after 109 revolutions (~600 k ... ~9 k r)" (main: length, 163) |
| adaptive_hsm::the_channel_names_the_trochoid_fallback_before_the_rings | ok | 9 s | none |
| adaptive_hsm::a_small_helix_rectangle_never_crosses_itself | ok | 2 s | none |
| pick_agnostic::every_pick_of_the_bore_cuts_the_same_bytes_under_hsm_adaptive | ok | 14 s | none |
| pick_agnostic::a_face_with_an_island_..._boss_full | ok | 30 s | none |
| stock_engine_agreement::the_pocket3d_consumers_read_both_engines_alike | ok | 9 s | none |
| budget::fixtures::the_fixtures_that_grow_today_stay_under_... | ok | 16 s | none (slot 252 k, channel 175 k) |
| adaptive_hsm::the_island_is_refused_..._in_seconds (release) | ok | 22 s | island, as above |

The final head e8def282 adds only a docs commit (decisions file numbers and the #882 link) on top of ecb54b7f.

## Review round (reviewer comment on e8def282)

- **Island pin over the 60 s law:** moved to the heavy lane, and a fast twin added (above).
- **NaN length, a deliberate behaviour change for degenerate input:** `Work::add_len` drops NaN, infinite and non-positive lengths. Before, a NaN poisoned the sum and switched off #13's length refusal for every later revolution. Now law 2 keeps counting. Pinned by `a_nan_length_neither_refuses_nor_disables_the_budget`; also recorded in the decisions file.
- **Bore digest:** replaced by asserted move, planar and arc counts plus the strategy list.
- **Refusal wording:** now plain English, saying both limits were passed. Example (island): "its outline is too detailed and its path too long to plan in seconds (an island?): both limits passed, ~600.0 k outline vertices processed (limit 600 k) and ~9.4 k tool radii of path (limit 5.0 k); ... - Offset rings cut this pocket instead".
- **Counters reachable from integration tests:** not done. The counts live in a per-plan `Planner` inside `pocket()`; reaching them would mean returning them through the toolpath or a global, which is more than a small accessor. The bore's walk margin (1.93x) and the rotary counts stay covered by their heavy tests' no-refusal and strategy assertions.
- `mod.rs` went from 435 to 431 lines: `push_walk` moved to `grow.rs`, and the `plan_within` wrapper was added.

## Gate (final head)

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base origin/main`: green on the final head (motion suites 57 s).
- clippy `-D warnings`: motion `--all-targets` and app `--test pocket3d_hsm` clean.
- Release, final code:
  - the moved island pin passes (20.5 s);
  - the app bore test passes with its new count and strategy assertions (213 s, run on 6b89fdf8; the later commit only touches the island test's parsing).
- The 13 heavy lanes were not re-run, since the counters and limits are unchanged since ecb54b7f (below).

## Not exercised

- No other `--ignored` lanes, and no release tier.
- The debug "before" time of the island.
- Byte comparison against main was done for the bore only (the digest). The other finishing plans are covered by the counts: a plan that never trips a refusal only gains a counter, so its path cannot change.

## What this means for #845

#845's held fix roughly doubles growth work.
- **Island:** it would now be refused at the same 600 k / 5 k r in about the same ~22 s instead of running even longer.
- **Plans that finish:** the slot (252 k), the rotary levels (306-358 k) and the boss (289 k) would land near or over 600 k while walking past 5 k r, so they would be refused. #845 must re-measure them, and raise `GEOM_MAX` with numbers if they still finish; the margin pins will fail and tell it.

Effort: high (no escalation; rework after the heavy-lane finding).

Changelog: Adaptive: the growth planner now refuses by name a plan that has worked heavy ring geometry over a long walk (deterministic counts), so an islanded area it cannot finish falls back to the named Offset rings in ~22 s instead of ~1 min; every plan that finishes today, the user's STEP bore included, is unchanged

Fixes #850
